title: Cybersecurity in Edge Computing: A Trust-Aware Federated Hybrid Intrusion Detection Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.39584v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Edge computing has emerged as a critical computing paradigm in modern distributed systems by migrating data processing closer to end users and Internet of Things (IoT) devices. While this paradigm decentralizes processes, minimizes latency, and reduces backhaul bandwidth congestion, it exponentially enlarges the cyberattack surface. Heterogeneous, resource-constrained edge devices deployed across unmanaged administrative domains present highly vulnerable targets. To address these vulnerabilities without compromising global data privacy regulations, this paper proposes a novel Trust-Aware Federated Hybrid Intrusion Detection Framework (TA-FHIDF). The proposed framework integrates an Autoencoder, a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN), and a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) model into a unified, localized deep learning engine capable of autonomous spatial and temporal feature extraction. translated_title: 边缘计算中的网络安全：一种信任感知的联邦混合入侵检测框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.39584v1 公告类型：交叉发布 摘要：边缘计算通过将数据处理迁移到更靠近终端用户和物联网设备的位置，已成为现代分布式系统中的一种关键计算范式。虽然这一范式实现了流程去中心化、最小化延迟并缓解了回程带宽拥塞，但它也呈指数级地扩大了网络攻击面。部署在非托管管理域中的异构且资源受限的边缘设备成为了极易受攻击的目标。为了在不违背全球数据隐私法规的前提下应对这些安全漏洞，本文提出了一种新颖的信任感知联邦混合入侵检测框架（TA-FHIDF）。该框架将自编码器、一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）和双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）集成到一个统一的、本地化的深度学习引擎中，能够自主进行空间和时间特征提取。模型训练以协作方式进行……
tldr: 本文提出了一种信任感知的联邦混合入侵检测框架（TA-FHIDF），通过将自编码器、1D-CNN和BiLSTM融合为统一的本地化深度学习引擎并结合联邦学习与信任机制，在保护数据隐私的同时有效检测边缘计算环境中扩大的网络攻击面。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Trust-Aware Federated Hybrid Intrusion Detection Framework (TA-FHIDF) that integrates an Autoencoder, 1D-CNN, and BiLSTM into a unified localized deep learning engine with federated learning and trust-awareness, enabling privacy-preserving intrusion detection for the expanded attack surface of edge computing environments.
